note: Planned chapter slugs use cN-MM matching the display chapter. Optional maths is the mathematics-for-ai module: math-NN lessons, one chapter each (M1 to M8). Pages: /mobile/lessons/genai-basics/chNN/<slug>/ and /mobile/lessons/chNN/<slug>/, except maths under chM. Curriculum id/needs remain existing keys; chapter/order are display data. Legacy aliases resolve through the shared path contract.

chapters.title: AI Foundations

lessons.title: How AI, ML, deep learning and GenAI fit together
lessons.learner_summary: See how AI, machine learning, deep learning and generative AI nest inside each other.
lessons.outcome: Explain the four nested rings; AI also includes rule-based approaches, so rules and learning are both AI. Include concrete task examples (predict, classify, recommend, generate) since 1.2 is Deep
lessons.misconception: Only systems that learn count as AI

lessons.title: AI in everyday products
lessons.learner_summary: Spot what task an everyday product's AI is doing: predicting, sorting, recommending or creating.
lessons.outcome: Name the task a product performs: predict, classify, recommend, generate, plan
lessons.touch: Sort product features into task types

lessons.title: Data, examples, features and labels
lessons.learner_summary: Learn what examples, features and labels are by reading a small table.
lessons.outcome: Identify examples, input features and labels; recap rules vs learning and unfamiliar cases as practice, not a new explanation
lessons.touch: Tap the label and features in a small table
lessons.misconception: Features and labels are the same thing

lessons.title: A model is not the app
lessons.learner_summary: Tell the learned model apart from the app around it by following one request.
lessons.outcome: Separate the learned model from interface, data sources and tools; trace one request
lessons.touch: Follow a request through a simple product diagram
lessons.misconception: The app and the model are one thing

lessons.title: Training vs inference
lessons.learner_summary: Understand the difference between training a model and using it.
lessons.outcome: Distinguish changing a model (training, retraining, adaptation) from using it; a prompt does not retrain it
lessons.misconception: Training happens once, or every chat retrains the model

lessons.title: What AI is good and bad at
lessons.learner_summary: Judge where AI is worth trusting and where you should check its work.
lessons.outcome: Judge where to trust and where to check; unfamiliar cases may be unreliable
lessons.touch: Rate tasks by stakes and checkability; no task is trusted without any checking

lessons.title: Using AI responsibly
lessons.learner_summary: Use AI with care: verify claims, protect private information and stay responsible.
lessons.outcome: Verify claims, protect sensitive information, keep human responsibility
lessons.touch: Scenario cards: what would you share?
lessons.misconception: The tool, not I, is accountable

chapters.purpose: Recognise AI's ingredients and the big picture.

chapters.title: How GenAI Works

lessons.title: What is a token
lessons.learner_summary: Find out why models read chunks of text called tokens, not words.
lessons.outcome: Models read chunks, not words; token counts relate to context limits and usage
lessons.touch: Type a sentence and watch it split (label as simulation if scripted)

lessons.title: How a model predicts the next token
lessons.learner_summary: See how a model writes one token at a time by picking from likely options.
lessons.outcome: Text is generated one token at a time from a probability distribution (teach the needed probability intuition here; formal probability is Deep)
lessons.touch: Candidate-token bars; one is chosen; repeat (simulation)

lessons.title: Where models learn: pretraining and data
lessons.learner_summary: Learn how training on large amounts of data shapes what a model knows and gets wrong.
lessons.outcome: Broad pretraining on large data shapes what a model knows and gets wrong
lessons.misconception: The model looks answers up at answer time

lessons.title: From base model to assistant
lessons.learner_summary: See how a raw model becomes an assistant that follows instructions.
lessons.outcome: Instruction tuning makes a base model follow instructions; differs from adding a prompt
lessons.touch: Guess which reply is base vs assistant
lessons.misconception: The only difference is the prompt

lessons.title: Parameters and model size
lessons.learner_summary: Learn what parameters are and why a bigger model is not always a better one.
lessons.outcome: Parameters are learned values; size relates to capacity, not guaranteed quality

lessons.title: The context window
lessons.learner_summary: Understand what a model can see at once, and why old text can drop out.
lessons.outcome: Current context, model weights and external memory are different; old text can fall out
lessons.touch: Resize a toy window; keep the newest turn and add older turns when they fit

lessons.title: Why models make things up
lessons.learner_summary: See why models sometimes sound sure and are wrong, and what helps.
lessons.outcome: Unsupported claims appear fluently; grounding helps but does not remove errors
lessons.misconception: A confident answer is a checked answer

lessons.title: Knowledge cutoff and fresh information
lessons.learner_summary: Learn why a model's knowledge stops at a date and how fresh facts get added.
lessons.outcome: Training data has a cutoff and coverage before it is incomplete; tools or supplied context can add newer facts
lessons.touch: Timeline illustrating freshness limits (no precise cutoff claims) and a 'today' question
lessons.misconception: It knows everything before the cutoff and nothing after

lessons.title: Temperature and sampling
lessons.learner_summary: See how temperature changes how varied a model's answers are.
lessons.outcome: Temperature changes the spread of next-token choices, not truth or safety

lessons.title: Reasoning models
lessons.learner_summary: Learn how reasoning models work through a problem before answering.
lessons.outcome: Reasoning models are trained to work through problems first; shown steps are not a verified record of the internal process
lessons.touch: Compare a quick and a reasoned answer (simulation)
lessons.misconception: Asking for steps makes any model a reasoning model

chapters.purpose: Understand how modern text models read, generate and fail.

chapters.title: Prompting and Working with AI

lessons.title: Giving clear goals and instructions
lessons.learner_summary: Turn a vague request into a clear task with a goal and an audience.
lessons.outcome: Turn a vague request into a task with audience and outcome
lessons.touch: Rewrite a vague prompt; compare replies

lessons.title: Providing context and constraints
lessons.learner_summary: Give an AI the right background and limits, and leave out what distracts.
lessons.outcome: Supply relevant background and limits; avoid sensitive or distracting text
lessons.touch: Build a prompt from context blocks

lessons.title: System instructions and roles
lessons.learner_summary: Use system instructions to set response rules and roles to guide perspective.
lessons.outcome: System instructions steer behaviour but are not guarantees
lessons.misconception: A role makes it an expert

lessons.title: Teaching through examples
lessons.learner_summary: Show a model a pattern with examples to guide its answer.
lessons.outcome: Examples show a pattern; they guide but do not guarantee, and do not change weights
lessons.touch: Add examples; watch the style shift

lessons.title: Requesting structured outputs
lessons.learner_summary: Ask for tables or fields, then check the result.
lessons.outcome: Ask for tables or fields and validate the result
lessons.misconception: Asking for a format guarantees it

lessons.title: Breaking complex tasks into steps
lessons.learner_summary: Split a big task into smaller steps you can check.
lessons.outcome: Split work into checkable subtasks

lessons.title: Improving an answer through iteration
lessons.learner_summary: Improve an answer with focused feedback and compare it with what you asked for.
lessons.outcome: Give targeted feedback; compare versions with the original requirements

lessons.title: Checking facts, sources and generated code
lessons.learner_summary: Check facts, sources and generated code before you rely on them.
lessons.outcome: Apply one verification principle to facts, citations and code; code practice is optional and needs no programming background
lessons.touch: Verify a flawed answer step by step
lessons.misconception: A citation means it is true

lessons.title: Choosing the right model for a task
lessons.learner_summary: Compare models on quality, cost, speed, memory and privacy for your own tasks.
lessons.outcome: Compare capability, cost, speed, context and privacy on your own tasks
lessons.misconception: The top leaderboard model suits every task

lessons.title: Deciding what to hand to AI
lessons.learner_summary: Decide which tasks to hand to AI by weighing the stakes and how easily you can check them.
lessons.outcome: Judge tasks by stakes, checkability and your own skill
lessons.touch: Sort tasks: hand over / work together / do myself

chapters.purpose: Specify tasks clearly and verify the work.

chapters.title: How Machines Learn

lessons.title: Supervised learning
lessons.learner_summary: Learn from examples that come with answers: inputs and the targets to predict.
lessons.outcome: Learn from examples with known answers; identify inputs and targets

lessons.title: Regression: predicting numbers
lessons.learner_summary: Read a fitted line and see why a predicted number is an estimate.
lessons.outcome: Read a fitted line; an estimate is not a guarantee
lessons.touch: Drag points; watch the line move

lessons.title: Classification: choosing categories
lessons.learner_summary: See how a score and a cut-off turn into a choice between categories.
lessons.outcome: A score plus a threshold becomes a category decision
lessons.misconception: The model knows the true class

lessons.title: Unsupervised learning and clustering
lessons.learner_summary: Find groups in data without labels, and see why a group may not match a human category.
lessons.outcome: Find groups without labels; a cluster may not match a human category

lessons.title: Self-supervised learning
lessons.learner_summary: See how data can supply its own answers, like hidden words in a sentence.
lessons.outcome: Data supplies its own targets, such as hidden text
lessons.touch: Hide a word and guess it

lessons.title: Reinforcement learning
lessons.learner_summary: Meet agents, actions and rewards, and why a reward can arrive late.
lessons.outcome: Agent, environment, action, reward; rewards can be delayed

lessons.title: Search and planning
lessons.learner_summary: Explore how a system searches for a route to a goal.
lessons.outcome: Explore routes toward a goal; different from learning patterns

lessons.title: Knowledge, rules and reasoning
lessons.learner_summary: See how facts and rules work, and how they combine with learned models.
lessons.outcome: Facts and rules; knowledge graphs; hybrids with learned models

chapters.purpose: Tell the main learning methods apart.

chapters.title: Data and Evaluation

lessons.title: Collecting representative data
lessons.learner_summary: Work out who a model is for and spot the cases your data is missing.
lessons.outcome: Define who and what a model serves; spot missing cases
lessons.touch: Find the missing group in a sample
lessons.misconception: More data is always better data

lessons.title: Cleaning data and missing values
lessons.learner_summary: Check data for errors and gaps, and see how cleaning choices change results.
lessons.outcome: Inspect formats, errors and gaps; cleaning choices change results

lessons.title: Probability and uncertainty
lessons.learner_summary: See why probabilities are estimates and what it means for them to be well calibrated.
lessons.outcome: Probabilities are estimates; calibration

lessons.title: Updating beliefs with evidence
lessons.learner_summary: Update what you believe as evidence arrives, with a simple worked example.
lessons.outcome: Simple Bayes example; rare events and false positives
lessons.misconception: A positive test means very likely true

lessons.title: Training, validation and test sets
lessons.learner_summary: Keep data for learning, for choosing settings and for a final fair check.
lessons.outcome: Separate learning, choosing settings and the final check
lessons.misconception: Reusing the test set is fine

lessons.title: Loss: measuring prediction errors
lessons.learner_summary: Measure how far predictions are off and why that is not the same as real-world results.
lessons.outcome: Error measure vs the real-world outcome
lessons.touch: Slide a line; watch the error

lessons.title: Overfitting and underfitting
lessons.learner_summary: Tell memorising the examples apart from missing the pattern.
lessons.outcome: Memorising vs missing the pattern

lessons.title: Accuracy, precision and recall
lessons.learner_summary: Read a confusion matrix and pick a measure that fits the cost of mistakes.
lessons.outcome: Read a confusion matrix; pick a metric for the cost of errors
lessons.touch: Move a threshold; see the trade-off

lessons.title: Data leakage and misleading results
lessons.learner_summary: See how leaked information or duplicates can make results look better than they are.
lessons.outcome: Future information or duplicates inflate scores
lessons.misconception: A high score means a good model

lessons.title: Performance across different groups
lessons.learner_summary: Compare results across different groups, not just the overall average.
lessons.outcome: Compare subgroup results, not just averages

chapters.purpose: Judge whether data and results justify trust.

chapters.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning

lessons.title: Neurons, weights and biases
lessons.learner_summary: See how weighted inputs and a bias make a neuron's output, and what changing a weight does.
lessons.outcome: Weighted inputs plus a bias; effect of changing a weight

lessons.title: Layers and activation functions
lessons.learner_summary: Stack units into layers and see why curves need nonlinear steps.
lessons.outcome: Stack units; nonlinearity
lessons.touch: Add a layer; see the boundary change

lessons.title: Gradient descent: improving predictions
lessons.learner_summary: Follow small corrections that reduce error, and the trade-off in step size.
lessons.outcome: Error (loss) guides small updates; learning-rate trade-off; loss is introduced here

lessons.title: Backpropagation
lessons.learner_summary: See how error information flows back through the layers.
lessons.outcome: Error informs gradients across layers; computing vs applying updates

lessons.title: Training settings: batches, epochs, learning rate
lessons.learner_summary: Learn what batches, epochs and learning rate control during training.
lessons.outcome: Examples per update, passes, step size

lessons.title: Embeddings: representing similarity
lessons.learner_summary: See how embeddings place similar things close together.
lessons.outcome: Vectors place similar items near each other; usefulness depends on model and task
lessons.touch: Drag points on a simplified map (labelled)

lessons.title: Vision and convolutional networks
lessons.learner_summary: Learn how networks read images with small filters over pixels.
lessons.outcome: Pixels and local filters; not every model learns edges-to-objects the same way
lessons.touch: Slide a filter over an image

lessons.title: Language, speech and sequence models
lessons.learner_summary: See why order matters for language and speech, and where older models fit in.
lessons.outcome: Order matters; recurrent models as a historical bridge

lessons.title: Attention and transformers
lessons.learner_summary: Understand how attention lets a model focus on the relevant parts of a sequence.
lessons.outcome: Combine relevant parts of a sequence; transformer structure at overview level (teach layer intuition here; 6.2 is Deep)
lessons.touch: Tap a word, see weights (simplified, labelled)

lessons.title: Neural networks vs other models
lessons.learner_summary: Choose between neural networks and other models using data, task, cost and results.
lessons.outcome: Choose with data, task, compute and measured results
lessons.touch: Pick a model for a case

chapters.purpose: Build intuition for how networks learn and represent.

chapters.title: Multimodal, Adaptation and Alignment

lessons.title: Multimodal AI: text, image, audio, video
lessons.learner_summary: Compare understanding, generating and transcribing across text, images, audio and video.
lessons.outcome: Interpretation vs generation vs transcription across modes

lessons.title: How diffusion image models work
lessons.learner_summary: See how image models turn noise into a picture step by step.
lessons.outcome: Iterative denoising as one approach; learned generation vs retrieval; possible memorisation

lessons.title: Alignment and preference training
lessons.learner_summary: Learn how human preferences shape replies, and why preferred is not the same as true.
lessons.outcome: Comparisons shape replies; preferred is not verified; proxy limits

lessons.title: Fine-tuning and adapters
lessons.learner_summary: See how a model is adapted with new examples, in full or with small add-ons.
lessons.outcome: Adapt a model on new examples; full vs parameter-efficient
lessons.touch: Attach an adapter to a large model

lessons.title: Scaling: why bigger helped and its limits
lessons.learner_summary: Learn why bigger models helped, and where the gains slow down.
lessons.outcome: Data, compute, parameters; diminishing returns; trade-offs

lessons.title: Interpretability: what we can and cannot see
lessons.learner_summary: See what we can and cannot learn by looking inside a model.
lessons.outcome: Methods for looking inside models; generated explanations are not the mechanism
lessons.touch: Compare an explanation with a probe (simplified)
lessons.misconception: A model can explain itself accurately

chapters.purpose: See beyond text and how models are shaped.

chapters.title: Retrieval and RAG Fundamentals

lessons.title: Why models need external knowledge
lessons.learner_summary: Understand when a model needs information from outside its learned parameters.
lessons.outcome: Missing, private, recent or specific knowledge; retrieve evidence when needed
lessons.touch: Sort: model knowledge or retrieve first
lessons.misconception: The model always knows current or private information

lessons.title: How retrieval-augmented generation works
lessons.learner_summary: Trace retrieve, build context and generate without changing model weights.
lessons.outcome: Retrieve, build context, generate; retrieval supplies evidence at inference time

lessons.title: Semantic search and vector databases
lessons.learner_summary: Compare keyword search with search by meaning and see how candidates are found.
lessons.outcome: Keyword versus embedding search; indexing and nearest candidates; limits

lessons.title: Chunking documents for retrieval
lessons.learner_summary: Choose useful document boundaries and see the trade-off between chunk sizes.
lessons.outcome: Chunks preserve enough meaning while remaining retrievable and within context limits

lessons.title: Candidate retrieval and reranking
lessons.learner_summary: Distinguish candidate retrieval from reranking and understand missing evidence.
lessons.outcome: Candidate set versus final ordering; poor candidates limit later stages
lessons.misconception: Reranking recovers evidence that was never retrieved

lessons.title: Evaluating evidence and generated answers
lessons.learner_summary: Separate retrieval failures from generation failures.
lessons.outcome: Check evidence relevance and answer support independently
lessons.misconception: A fluent answer proves retrieval was good

chapters.purpose: Explain how models use information outside their learned parameters.

chapters.title: Tools and Agents Fundamentals

lessons.title: Tool calling and structured actions
lessons.learner_summary: Trace a model-proposed action through validation, permissions and execution.
lessons.outcome: The model proposes; software validates, authorises and executes

lessons.title: Workflows versus agents
lessons.learner_summary: Classify tasks as fixed workflows, agent loops or combinations.
lessons.outcome: Fixed steps versus model-selected next actions

lessons.title: The agent loop: goals, observations and actions
lessons.learner_summary: Step through a goal, observation, decision and action loop.
lessons.outcome: Goals, observations, decisions and actions form a revisable loop
lessons.touch: Advance one loop step at a time
lessons.misconception: An agent makes one complete plan and never revises it

lessons.title: Agent state, memory and planning
lessons.learner_summary: Distinguish current state, stored memory, plans and model parameters.
lessons.outcome: State supports a run; memory may persist; plans can change; weights do not automatically change
lessons.touch: Classify information by storage and lifetime

lessons.title: Permissions and approval gates
lessons.learner_summary: Design approval boundaries for reversible and consequential actions.
lessons.outcome: Action scopes and approvals should match risk
lessons.misconception: A useful agent should be fully autonomous

lessons.title: Failure recovery and safe stopping
lessons.learner_summary: Choose safe responses when tools fail or actions exceed limits.
lessons.outcome: Retry only when safe; stop, ask or compensate when necessary
lessons.touch: Choose retry, ask, compensate or stop

lessons.title: Evaluating agents across runs
lessons.learner_summary: Compare agents across completion, errors, cost, latency and unsafe actions.
lessons.outcome: Reliability requires representative runs and failure cases

chapters.purpose: Explain how models interact with software and take actions.

chapters.title: Designing AI Features

lessons.title: Does this problem need AI
lessons.learner_summary: Compare AI with rules, search and ordinary software before choosing an approach.
lessons.outcome: Start with the user problem, acceptable error and success criteria

lessons.title: Choosing a model and a baseline
lessons.learner_summary: Compare a model with a simple baseline and practical constraints.
lessons.outcome: Baseline, quality, cost, speed, reliability and access
lessons.misconception: The biggest model is automatically best

lessons.title: Prompting, retrieval and fine-tuning
lessons.learner_summary: Match prompting, retrieval and fine-tuning to the problem.
lessons.outcome: Prompting supplies instructions; retrieval supplies changing evidence; fine-tuning changes behaviour
lessons.misconception: Fine-tuning fixes missing or current knowledge

lessons.title: Fine-tuning and adaptation fundamentals
lessons.learner_summary: Explain what adaptation changes and why regressions require checking.
lessons.outcome: Adaptation can change style or behaviour and can harm other cases

lessons.title: Task-specific evaluation
lessons.learner_summary: Build representative tests and a rubric around real user needs.
lessons.outcome: Automated checks and human review each have limits

lessons.title: Defining quality and success criteria
lessons.learner_summary: Turn a vague feature goal into observable success and failure conditions.
lessons.outcome: Define acceptable error, user impact, coverage and escalation

chapters.purpose: Decide whether AI is appropriate and define how success will be measured.

chapters.title: Operating AI Systems

lessons.title: Cost, latency and quality trade-offs
lessons.learner_summary: Compare end-to-end quality, streaming versus total latency, and cost per successful task.

lessons.title: Deployment choices: APIs, self-hosting and local
lessons.learner_summary: Compare hosted APIs, self-managed serving and local execution across control, cost and ops.

lessons.title: Model compression and re-evaluation
lessons.learner_summary: See how quantisation and distillation shrink models and why compressed outputs need fresh checks.

lessons.title: Caching, batching and model routing
lessons.learner_summary: Match prompt or semantic caching, batching and model routing to each workload safely.

lessons.title: Reliability, rate limits and graceful fallbacks
lessons.learner_summary: Design timeouts, bounded retries, fallback models and graceful non-AI recovery paths.

lessons.title: Tracing, monitoring and drift
lessons.learner_summary: Combine request traces with live quality, latency and drift signals to investigate anomalies.

lessons.title: Feedback and improvement loops
lessons.learner_summary: Triage explicit and implicit user feedback and turn validated failures into evaluation tests.

lessons.title: Experiments, staged releases and rollback
lessons.learner_summary: Plan offline replay, staged rollouts and fast rollback triggers for AI system updates.

chapters.purpose: Introduce deployment, cost, monitoring and controlled release decisions.

chapters.title: Responsible AI, Safety and Security

lessons.title: Prompt injection and unsafe tool use
lessons.learner_summary: Recognise untrusted text that tries to redirect an AI system, and limit what a redirected system can do.
lessons.outcome: Recognise untrusted text trying to redirect a system
lessons.misconception: Only the user can give instructions

lessons.title: Privacy and sensitive data
lessons.learner_summary: Trace where personal information is collected, sent, stored and exposed.
lessons.outcome: Trace where personal information is collected, sent, stored and exposed

lessons.title: Fairness and discrimination
lessons.learner_summary: Explain how data, labels and decisions can disadvantage groups and compare fairness measures.
lessons.outcome: Explain how data, labels and decisions can disadvantage groups

lessons.title: Copyright, ownership and provenance
lessons.learner_summary: Identify licensing, attribution and provenance questions.
lessons.outcome: Identify licensing, attribution and provenance questions
lessons.touch: Choose the next rights or terms check
lessons.misconception: AI output is always free to use

lessons.title: Misinformation and synthetic media
lessons.learner_summary: Assess misleading claims and verification limits.
lessons.outcome: Assess misleading claims and verification limits
lessons.touch: Inspect a claim and evidence path

lessons.title: Explainability and transparency
lessons.learner_summary: Distinguish explaining a prediction from documenting a system.
lessons.outcome: Distinguish explaining a prediction from documenting a system
lessons.misconception: A fluent explanation is the real mechanism

lessons.title: Misuse and red-team testing
lessons.learner_summary: Turn a misuse case into a test and interpret results cautiously.
lessons.outcome: Turn a misuse case into a test and interpret results cautiously
lessons.touch: Write or select an adversarial test

lessons.title: Human oversight, accountability and governance
lessons.learner_summary: Assign responsibility for decisions, incidents and user recourse.
lessons.outcome: Assign responsibility for decisions, incidents and user recourse

lessons.title: Capstone: design and evaluate an AI feature
lessons.learner_summary: Link user needs, methods, tests, costs, permissions, human review, failure handling and safety.
lessons.outcome: Link user needs, methods, tests, costs, permissions, human review, failure handling and safety
lessons.misconception: A feature list is a design

chapters.purpose: Identify harms, safeguards, security risks and accountability needs.

chapters.title: Python for AI
chapters.purpose: Python for AI, lessons p1-01 to p1-11.

lessons.title: Vectors and similarity
lessons.learner_summary: The maths behind similarity. Pairs with 6.6 Embeddings.

lessons.title: Matrices and transformations
lessons.learner_summary: The maths of transforming data. Pairs with 6.1 Neurons, weights and biases.

lessons.title: Functions and graphs
lessons.learner_summary: Read functions and graphs. Pairs with 6.1 Neurons, weights and biases.

lessons.title: Derivatives and gradients
lessons.learner_summary: The maths behind learning updates. Pairs with 6.3 Gradient descent.

lessons.title: Probability distributions
lessons.learner_summary: Describe uncertainty with distributions. Pairs with 5.3 Probability and uncertainty.

lessons.title: Statistics and sampling
lessons.learner_summary: Learn from samples with statistics. Pairs with 5.1 Collecting representative data.

lessons.title: Information, entropy and cross-entropy
lessons.learner_summary: Measure surprise with entropy. Pairs with 2.2 How a model predicts the next token.
lessons.pairs_with: 2.2 (How a model predicts the next token)

lessons.title: Optimisation and regularisation
lessons.learner_summary: Tune models and avoid overfitting. Pairs with 5.7 Overfitting and underfitting.
